overview: Very safe, clean and efficient, with Tokyo Disney and DisneySea, Universal Studios Japan in Osaka, bullet trains, temples in Kyoto and friendly deer in Nara.
fit: Outstanding for both kids; lots of walking, so bring a light stroller for the 4-year-old.
season: Late March–early April is cherry blossom (busy and pricey); May and October–November are lovely (15–22°C). June is the rainy season; July–August is very hot and humid. Avoid Golden Week (early May) crowds.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Tokyo or Osaka (1-stop via Singapore, Bangkok, KL or Delhi)

gettingAround: Trains everywhere with a Suica/ICOCA card (in the phone wallet). Kids under 6 ride free.

todo.title: Tokyo Disneyland or DisneySea
todo.book: Buy dated tickets online; weekdays are calmer

todo.title: Universal Studios Japan, Osaka
todo.book: Timed entry to Nintendo World; consider Express Pass

todo.title: Nara Park
todo.why: Bowing deer and the giant Buddha

todo.title: Shinkansen ride
todo.why: Bullet train itself is an attraction

food.name: Ramen and udon
food.note: Ask for vegetarian broth where possible

foodTips: Vegetarian is harder; use apps like HappyCow and carry snacks.
save: Avoid cherry blossom peak and Golden Week
Compare a JR Pass with single Shinkansen tickets (often single tickets are cheaper now)
safety: Earthquake drill: know your hotel's exit
Crowded trains at rush hour: avoid 8–9 am
health: Pharmacies are good; carry your kids' usual medicines
visa: Indian passport holders can apply for a Japan e-visa (single-entry tourist) through the VFS centre; processing about a week, fee roughly ₹500 per person. Apply 1–2 months ahead. Check the latest on the Embassy of Japan in India website.
